notes:
DX9 vtable label fixes: 0xBD2710 was labelled uEm019_00::vftable but its getDTI slot (+0x10) is uEm019_string::getDTI -> relabelled uEm019_string::vftable; the real uEm019_00::vftable is 0xBD2568 (slot4 = uEm019_00::getDTI, 107 slots, ctor 0x66C110). uEm019_lure::vftable = 0xBD2290 (ctor 0x668E40). Consequently the 'vt' tags for uEm019_00 in dx9_uem_features.json are really uEm019_string's slots.
uEm019_00's dtor (0x66C490) also writes uEm019_string::vftable, so uEm019_string objects are embedded in uEm019_00. The uEm019 TU also holds uEm019_lure (lure methods at 0x668E40-0x66B930), and the uEm019_00 TU holds uEm019_string (0x66B930-0x66C110).
Defined 18 previously undefined functions in the span: scalar/vector deleting dtors (vtable slot 0) and MyDTI::newInstance stubs (0x649CB0, 0x64A420, 0x668EE0, 0x66B970, 0x66C460, 0x67D010, 0x67D160, 0x67ECA0, 0x67ED40, 0x67FAB0, 0x684670, 0x684710, 0x719140, 0x719340, 0x71AB70, 0x71ABD0, 0x71B2C0, 0x71B550). The uEm033Shl ctor is inlined into its newInstance (0x71AB70).
DX9 slot -> SE method map used for enemy vtables: 0 dtor, 3 createProperty, 4 getDTI, 5 setup, 6 move, 7 moveEx, 8 sync, 9 draw, 12 kill, 29 updateMaterial, 30 main, 31 updatePtr, 36 damageMessage, 37 hitMessage, 40 holyWaterMessage, 45 guardMessage, 47 dieMessage, 48 injureMessage, 49 interruptMessage, 50 blownMessage, 57 customMessage, 74 isMotionEnd, 76 getEffectElementMessage, 77 setDevilTrigger, 82 getMaxHitPoint, 87 grabShortMessage, 88 grabLongMessage, 97 isPlayerGrab. For shells/actors (77-80 slots): 77 preMain, 78 die, 79 postMain. uEm019_00 adds 103 getNextNode, 104 getTarNodePos, 105 getNearNode.
Existing DX9 names: slot-12 'X::die' (uEm019/uEm033/uEm035) renamed to the SE name 'kill'. SE has a separate die method, e.g. uEm035::die is a state routine now at 0x721630. Slot-31 'X::validateTargetPtrs' renamed to the SE name 'updatePtr' (consistent with group C). The old names are kept in comments ('was:').
uEm033::main dispatches through a function-pointer table at 0xE153E4: appear, footwork, atkPunch, demoPunch, atkLaser (= shared nullsub 0x507330), dmgBuster. This matches the SE setAction enum order. uEm019, uEm019_00 and uEm035 main() are switch statements whose call order matches SE 1:1.
SE-only: uEm035::damageAir/setDamageAir (no damageAir action in the DX9 uEm035::main switch), the setDeltaTimeRate virtuals (uEm019, lure, uEm019_00), uEm019_00::adjustChain (24 KB), get_warp_pos2, dispThinkTbl (debug), and the cThinkMgr debug draw calls inside draw(). SE allocator boilerplate (operator new/delete, usage) has no DX9 counterpart.
DX9-only: 0x649CA0 and 0x66B950 are COMDAT getters shared with other enemy vtables (not renamed). 0x67C0B0, 0x67E5A0, 0x6845E0 and 0x6851B0 are the SE free functions setEm019_00, setEm019_ice (two per-TU statics) and setEm019ShlLand; they are commented only.
uEm035 setDamageInterrupt_L/_R (0x71DF40/0x71DF80) are picked at random by interruptMessage, so the L/R assignment is order-based only (medium).
